continuity.arc_goal: Implement complete linked services system across three phases: Phase A (object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade), Phase A.2 (refactor completion model from LinkedFrom-as-sink to unified response_sinks on both VO and WI; eliminate LinkCompletionSink type), Phase B (workflow invocation linking with InvocationEdges, StartLinkedCommand, coupled link+invocation semantics, InvocationStatus::Completing, and full link matrix: VO↔VO, VO↔WI, WI↔VO, WI↔WI)

progress_update.summary: Phase A.2 + B implementation complete through multiple refactor passes. We landed the Unified Response Sinks refactor (commit 4c1ac82c8) which eliminated LinkCompletionSink and unified completion dispatch across VO and WI via response_sinks on both entity types. Two code review rounds caught critical bugs: a silent cross-partition hang when StartLinkedCommand targets an idempotent deduped child, and an unsafe JSON encoding in fire_service_completion that would break on error messages containing quotes. Both fixed in commit b14948f22. Branch has 22 integration tests passing, 174/174 full worker suite passing.
progress_update.goal: Complete linked services Phase A.2 + Phase B: unified completion dispatch model, full link matrix (VO↔VO, VO↔WI, WI↔VO, WI↔WI), InvocationStatus::Completing lifecycle, AttachServiceCommand for WI→VO awaiting, Option A command/handle split, clean and reviewable code that preserves Phase A behaviors.
accomplished: Implemented Phase A (Session 5): ServiceEdges table, ServiceNodeId, VirtualObjectStatus::Completed, LinkServiceCommand, CompleteServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceCommand with journal types, proto, codec, outbox, WAL dispatch, state machine handlers; fixed 3 code review findings (cycle detection, external state mutation, failure encoding); 9 commits, 6/6 tests

Designed Phase A.2 + B (Session 6): produced plan_phase_a2.md, plan_phase_b.md, combined 25-subtask breakdown with dependency analysis and parallel execution waves; key innovations: LinkedFrom-as-completion-sink model, LinkCompletionSink enum, LinkCompletionNotification unified message, InvocationEdges table, StartLinkedCommand with link response sink, coupled link+invocation semantics

Implemented Phase A.2 refactor (Session 7 final): eliminated LinkCompletionSink type entirely; replaced with ServiceInvocationResponseSink::ServiceCompletion(ServiceCompletionTarget); refactored VirtualObjectStatus to struct variants (Locked { invocation_id, response_sinks } / Unlocked { response_sinks }) with Completed staying as tuple variant (type-enforced terminal); EdgeState::LinkedFrom simplified to presence-only; unified response_sinks on both VO and WI entity types instead of maintaining two dispatch pipes

Fixed two critical code review findings in b14948f22: (C1) silent hang when StartLinkedCommand targets idempotent deduped child — added on_link_from_deduplicated_invocation helper, capture link_from metadata before handle_duplicated_requests; (C2) unsafe JSON encoding in fire_service_completion — replaced format-string with serde_json::to_vec on typed FailurePayload struct

Completed Option A split for Unlink commands: UnlinkServiceCommand/UnlinkInvocationCommand split by target type, added completion flow (previously @no_completion), polymorphic UnlinkRequest/UnlinkResponse for cross-partition
Deleted AttachLinkCommand entirely — Phase A's AttachInvocationCommand handles linked WI children unchanged via response_sinks path; AttachServiceCommand handles linked VO children via new mechanism

Test coverage at 22 linked_services tests: full matrix (VO↔VO, VO↔WI, WI↔VO, WI↔WI), Completing lifecycle, short-circuit path for already-completed targets, VO unlink sink cleanup, WI unlink preservation of PartitionProcessor sinks (critical 'WI blocks forever' regression guard), idempotent dedup + link establishment, special-character failure JSON encoding
progress_update.now: All planned work for Phase A.2 + B is complete. 22/22 linked_services tests pass, 174/174 worker suite passes. Clean cargo check/fmt/clippy. Branch at commit b14948f22. One known follow-up: retention inheritance for fire_service_completion (IMPORTANT-1 from review was partially addressed — unused param removed, but threading completion_retention_duration through send_response_to_sinks was deferred as it touches 13 call sites).

SDK work: Phase A.2 + B requires SDK-side implementation (sdk-shared-core + Rust SDK) for StartLinkedCommand, AttachServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceCommand, UnlinkInvocationCommand, and the new LinkServiceCommand shape
constraints: Phase A behaviors preserved: cycle detection, GC cascade, external state mutation guard, stale edge cleanup, JSON failure encoding in onCompleted handler
VirtualObjectStatus now has struct variants (Locked { invocation_id, response_sinks } / Unlocked { response_sinks }); Completed stays as tuple variant with no sinks (terminal, type-enforced)
LinkCompletionSink type fully deleted — ServiceInvocationResponseSink::ServiceCompletion(ServiceCompletionTarget) is the replacement
EdgeState::LinkedFrom is presence-only — all callback data lives in target entity's response_sinks
WI unlinker MUST NOT filter response_sinks (would break WI blocking on attach sink)
has_links flag on InFlightInvocationMetadata still gates RocksDB scans in end_invocation for performance
AttachInvocationCommand handles linked WI child awaiting unchanged — Phase A mechanism; AttachServiceCommand handles VO child awaiting via new path
ServiceNodeId → EntityId rename throughout (not retroactive); LinkServiceResponse → LinkResponse unified; ServiceCompletionNotification → LinkCompletionNotification
All tables logical within one RocksDB CF per partition — 2-byte KeyKind prefix
WAL serialization must remain backward compatible (Option<T> defaults to None)
Proto type IDs: LinkService=0x0415/0x8015, CompleteService=0x0416/0x8016, UnlinkService=0x0417/0x8017
decisions: Unified response sinks on both VO and WI entity types rather than maintaining two dispatch pipes (LinkedFrom-based for VO completion, response_sinks for WI)
VirtualObjectStatus::Locked/Unlocked gain inline response_sinks as struct variants; Completed has no sinks field (type-enforced terminal state) — matches Phase A's InvocationStatus pattern
Two link establishment paths: Path A (LinkServiceCommand → LinkRequest round-trip) for existing children; Path B (StartLinkedCommand → ServiceInvocation.link_from piggyback) for new WI children

Already-completed target short-circuits: on_link_request fires handler immediately with stored result, emits LinkCompletionNotification for edge transition, sends LinkResponse(Ok) — mirrors AttachInvocationCommand semantics
Option A split for unlink commands: UnlinkServiceCommand (VO target) / UnlinkInvocationCommand (WI target) — type-level split at command layer only
AttachLinkCommand deleted entirely — Phase A's AttachInvocationCommand handles the WI child await case natively via response_sinks path
Coupled link+invocation semantics: StartLinkedCommand link failure rejects the invocation entirely
Two edge tables: ServiceEdges (VO parents, service-level) + InvocationEdges (WI parents, invocation-scoped)
ServiceEdgeState uses proto oneof to unify edge label + state — no separate edge_label param on put_service_edge
LinkedFrom edges store a minimal ServiceEdgeState::LinkedFrom proto value (not empty bytes) to prevent deserialization errors
onCompleted handler encodes failure details as JSON in typed FailurePayload (not format-string) — safe for special characters
LinkServiceResponse carries remote_node_id for stale edge cleanup on error
Vertical command slices: each command task covers full stack (journal + proto + codec + outbox + WAL)
GC cascade: no parents + Completed → delete state/promises/status/edges + propagate UnlinkServiceRequest to children
Phase A ships independently from Phase B — Phase A anchors only objects, Phase B adds WorkflowInvocation nodes
